title: Ancient Ruins of Galthar
summary: An exploration into the ruins of a once-great magical civilization.
description: Deep within the Whispering Woods lie the ruins of Galthar. Adventurers seek the Heart of Galthar, a powerful relic guarded by ancient constructs.

acts.name: The Descent
acts.region_description: A crumbled stone gate guarded by ivy-covered statues.
acts.exit_criteria: Find the stone key and open the gate.

sequences.name: Gatekeeper's Challenge
sequences.location_description: A mossy gatehouse where the first guardians wait.
sequences.description: As you approach, the statues begin to move.

enemies.name: Stone Sentinel
enemies.description: A massive animated statue with a cracked shield.

items.name: Ancient Stone Key
items.description: A heavy key carved from black granite.

sequences.name: Echoing Hall
sequences.location_description: A long hall where every footstep echoes unnaturally.
sequences.description: The walls are lined with fading murals of the old kings.

npcs.name: Ghost of a Scholar
npcs.description: A translucent figure frantically searching through invisible papers.
